stories.title: What do other planets smell like? The answer hides in their chemistry
stories.summary: Humanity has long looked up and yearned to know more about the glowing dots in the night sky. Over the past century, advances in technology have allowed us to glean amazingly good insights into both distant stars and our closest cosmic neighbors.

stories.title: The AQI paradox: Why the official count may be downplaying the pollution problem | HT Explainers
stories.summary: On November 10, two days after Diwali, the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) cautioned people against trusting apps that "derive AQI from instantaneous hourly readings", because the national air quality index (AQI), it said, reflects "prolonged exposure, rather than a momentary reading". It was an odd caution to come from the board.

stories.title: What does the Constitution say about proroguing Parliament? | Explained
stories.summary: Parliament adjourned sine die on August 13, at the end of the last sitting of the Monsoon Session. However, they have not been prorogued to date, making it the longest unprorogued period on record. Article 85 of the Constitution provides for summoning and prorogation of the Houses of Parliament.

stories.title: COP31 ends without a deal: Why talks collapsed and what was left undone | HT Explainers
stories.summary: COP31, the United Nations ’ annual climate summit, ended without a deal in Antalya on Sunday, after the European Union, the UK and several climate-vulnerable countries rejected the final text, leaving the questions of fossil fuels and climate finance unresolved. At the closing plenary on Sunday afternoon, COP31 president Murat Kurum, who is also Turkey’s environment minister, told countries the proposed Antalya pact did not have consensus.

stories.title: Bisleri water sample fails FSSAI test: What did inspectors find? What action was taken? What we know
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has approved prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd after a sample of its packaged drinking water was declared unsafe. The food safety regulator said the sample did not meet the prescribed limits for bromate. It was also found to contain polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) during further testing at a referral laboratory.

stories.title: GTA 6 story explained: Who are Jason and Lucia, and what role do they play in the world of Grand Theft Auto

stories.title: From entire towers to entire floors, Mumbai investors drive big-ticket property deals | Real Estate News
stories.summary: An emerging trend in Mumbai’s luxury property market is seeing ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNIs) move beyond buying individual apartments or office units to acquiring entire residential towers and commercial floors. While one buyer may be looking for the privacy and exclusivity of a private mansion, another may see an entire office floor as a long-term investment, a future workplace or a source of rental income.

stories.title: ‘Home-sick’: Mumbai exhibition explores Himalayan medicinal plants and disappearing habitats
stories.summary: By definition, homesickness refers to the unhappiness one experiences when away from home for an extended period. However, for Garima Gupta, an artist and researcher based in New Delhi, the term takes on a more layered meaning. Through her exhibition Home-sick, currently on view at TARQ, Gupta considers sickness as both a symptom and a witness — a condition through which stories of exhaustion, displacement and care become perceptible.

stories.title: Mumbai twin-tunnel project to connect Sea Link to BKC, airport Terminal 2 to Eastern Express Highway | Mumbai news
